findings.claim: The Revu article warns that revised drawing measurements can remain outdated and that recalibration can accidentally alter already-correct pages. Its viewport example keeps independent scale and updates only affected measurements after comparison.
findings.application: A replacement drawing needs its own validated source geometry/scale; unaffected current measurements remain. Do not treat the source product feature or page-range calibration option as authority to copy old scale facts, coordinates, captures or reading links to a new revision.
